name: Pull requests
author: Hayden
description: Shows how many GitHub pull requests are waiting on you, opens them in the browser from a paged dropdown, and sends any of them to the coding agents installed on this machine for review.

barWidget.description: Counts the open pull requests that need your response, lists them ten at a time, and hands one to your coding agents for a review.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll GitHub for pull requests.

schema.label: Pull requests per page
schema.description: How many pull requests each page of the panel shows.

schema.label: Bar count shows
schema.description: Whether the bar counts only the pull requests needing a response, or every open pull request that involves you.

schema.label: Max pull requests fetched per search
schema.description: How many results to fetch per search. The panel says so when there were more.

schema.label: Hide the icon when nothing needs you
schema.description: Remove the icon from the bar entirely when nothing needs you, instead of dimming it.

schema.label: Agents to review with
schema.description: Which coding agents a review is sent to by default. Only the ones installed on this machine are offered, and the picker still lets you change the choice per pull request. Leave empty to use whichever agent `omarchy agent` launches.

schema.label: Review working directory
schema.description: Where a review agent starts. Leave empty for ~/Work, or your home directory when that does not exist. Reviews read the pull request through the GitHub CLI, so this only decides which directory the agent trusts.
